edi_broker.text: Good day. Shares for the prudent investor. And for the other sort, at the same commission.

edi_saver.text: Spread your money about, buy good companies, and leave them be. Dividends every quarter. Dull, but dull pays.
Now that Doggerel nonsense down in London? Aye, I'll pass. A coin about a dog. Away wi' ye.

guild_traders.text: Buy low, sell high, and keep the receipts.

edi_auctioneer.text: Lots from the Enclosure's estate, once the Moot's had its say. Real hills, real woods, real bog, and a reserve on each. Care to see the catalogue?
